title: Bryce Harper says he "did not consent" to FanDuel video being used for commercial purposes
summary: The popular sports betting site FanDuel is accused of catering to its biggest spenders with VIP rewards, including a video from 2024 of baseball star Bryce Harper. Harper said he had no idea how the video would be used, but the fan he made it for is now suing FanDuel. Jo Ling Kent reports.
